race.description: Mark Kirchner Food Services Mdn Plate
race.comment: ROLLIN'ONTHERIVER (13) ran easily the best race of her four so far when third over 2000m at Warrnambool last start. Ridden more aggressively that day which seemed to do the trick. Should enjoy the extra 200m now and is a great chance to break through. ALLTOGETHERNOW (1) started a move before the turn then kept finding to finish runner-up over 2000m at the Bool last time out. Has had plenty of chances but is right in this if he can repeat that latest effort. CONJURER (2) made it three minor placings in a row when a well-held third over 2000m at St Arnaud recently. Rock hard fit after four runs back and looks ready for another tilt at this longer journey. MOSSQUILLO (6) steps up sharply in trip but lines up for just the third time so there is plenty of scope for improvement. ALL MOONLITE (8) ran a better race last start at St Arnaud and is in the mix with a repeat of the performance.
